REQUIREMENTS:
- Add new todos (input + button or Enter key)
- Mark todos as complete (checkbox toggle, applies strikethrough styling)
- Delete todos (delete button per item)
- Filter buttons: All / Active / Completed (mutually exclusive, show correct subset)
- Persist all todos to localStorage (load on init, save on every mutation)
- Self-contained: single .html file with inline <style> and <script>, no external CDN/links
- Filename: todo_openrouter-minimax-minimax-m3_01.html

DESIGN GUIDANCE:
- Clean, modern look. Centered card on a soft background, rounded corners, subtle shadow.
- Distinct visual states: hover, focus, completed (strikethrough + muted color).
- Show counts (e.g. "X items left") and a "Clear completed" button when applicable.
- Empty-state message when no todos match the current filter.
- Accessible: labels for inputs, buttons have aria-labels where appropriate, semantic HTML (<main>, <ul>/<li>, <button>).
- Responsive: usable on mobile widths.

TECHNICAL:
- Vanilla JS, no frameworks.
- Use a unique id (e.g. crypto.randomUUID() with a fallback) for each todo so toggles/deletes target the right item even with duplicate text.
- Store as JSON array under one localStorage key (e.g. 'todos').
- Render function rebuilds the list from state + current filter; do not rely on innerHTML for user-controlled text — use textContent / DOM APIs (or escape on innerHTML).
- Filter buttons update an active state visually.
